name: Havoc
summary: "Havoc" puts you in the cockpit of a Soviet Mi-28 attack helicopter – or an AH-64 Apache if you prefer – as you battle through seven war zones. Each level ends with a powerful helicopter boss that must be destroyed. Enemy planes and ground installations stand in your way, but friendly units also fly nearby – hitting them turns allies into enemies and causes you to lose collected bonuses. To support your mission, you can gather packs that restore damage, lives, and weapons. Precision, strategy, and quick reflexes are key to completing your mission successfully.
